summary: Adversarial fail for Phase 2: 4 new guards in the adversarial file; 2 pass (D12 week 1 stop, PRINT_GATE kind) and 2 fail on shipped code and expose 2 production defects for Green (v3 --print default folder overwrites the approved mock; print render leaks draft-week words when one week is draft).
blocking_findings: ADV-P2-1 | severity: medium | blocking | dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-storytime-book-cover.ts:209-216 (and dashboard/lib/storytime/print/covers.ts:772-788) | A '--version 3 --print' build without --out writes into proof-v3/l2u1, the folder of the approved Drive mock. Test ADV-P2-OUT (commit 13f0053a) seeds that folder in a temp HOME. The build exits 0 and adds the PDF/X file and replaces back.png, build-report.json and others. This is the C-P2-01 defect, now shown by a failing test. Fix route: Green makes --print require --out, or gives --print its own default folder print-v<n>; the test then passes (a patched copy that exits 2 passes it).

ADV-P2-2 | severity: medium | blocking | dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-storytime-book-cover.ts:248 with :249-259 and :324 | Rule 7 and D12 say a draft week supplies no field data in the printer file. The D12 stop uses approved-only values (line 251), but the render uses panelValues from ALL weeks (line 248, used at line 324). If one week of 2 to 8 goes back to draft, no field empties, the stop is silent, and the print build exits 0 with that week's words on the back page. Test ADV-P2-D12 'only week 3' (commit 92476880) shows 'get', 'Paint!' and 'The Pan' in the Chrome PDF text. This is ADV-P1-1, which was latent and is now reachable because weeks 2 to 8 ship approved. Fix route: Green sets panelValues = approvedValues when print && version >= 3 (a patched copy with that line passes the test).
nonblocking_findings: ADV-P2-3 | severity: low | nonblocking | PRINT_GATE age rule | The Green gate 'file newer than git log -1 of its sources' (test-strategy section 5) is a manual check. No code compares the age of the print file with its sources, so a test cannot pin it. The kind rule is pinned: ADV-P2-GATE shows that the gate exits 1 on a Chrome-like PDF, also under the _PDFX-1a.pdf name, and exits 2 on a missing file.
